subject: Question about the symposium draft
text: Hi Professor, Hope you're doing well. I'm putting the finishing touches on the symposium program and wanted to ping you quickly, since you have such a good eye for these things. One little thought: would it feel smoother if the short participant welcome came right after the coffee break instead of before? I keep imagining folks arriving a bit early, then rushing to their first talk with coffee still dripping, and I'd hate the day to feel clunky. I'm mostly trying to keep the morning from feeling like a sprint, but I also don't want to step on the keynote's natural build-up or make sponsors think we're winging it. If the switch helps, I'll shuffle the room bookings; if it creates a bottleneck, totally fair. Any blunt feedback you can spare would be a huge help before I send the draft to finance. Also, if you have a quick second, let me know whether the panel intro should be a slide or spoken warmly. I'm open to your nudge.
